text:
maya (People Ops): Heads up 1 1 We have a candidate flying in next month for a loop of interviews + a product dinner. Candidate asked if we can cover airport transfers, and whether we pay per-diem for travel day. Also they booked a refundable economy fare on their own. Thoughts on receipts/limits?

tom (Recruiting Ops): Quick rules: we reimburse actual coach fares up to the hiring cap (usually $600 domestic). No per-diem for candidates. Airport rides (Uber/Lyft/taxi) reimbursable with receipt up to $75 each way; rideshares must include trip receipt (screenshot ok). If candidate paid with cash, need a photo of receipt + bank transfer proof if we reimburse.

Priya (Finance): Add: for transfers in foreign currency include a card statement or proof of exact USD charge or the app conversion screenshot. We don't convert handwritten receipts. Receipts must show date, vendor, and amount. For fares > $1,000 get travel@approval in advance.

dan (Hiring Manager): The dinner plan includes the candidate + 3 interviewers and one product partner (non-employee). Will the partner's portion be covered?

tom (Recruiting Ops): Non-employee/partner = not reimbursable. If it's a mixed bill, company covers only the candidate portion and internal interviewer meals per head if on company card. If interviewer brings partner, partner's meal must be excluded.

maya (People Ops): What if interviewer uses personal card and uploads single receipt with partner line? Any preferred note?

Priya (Finance): Add a short note in expense app: "Candidate dinner - Alice Zhang - candidate portion $xx - partner excluded" and attach the receipt. If the app supports itemized split, great; if not, include a screenshot with the partner items circled or a 1-line CSV indicating portions. We need the math.

travel-bot: TravelBot: Reminder: Candidate claims must be submitted within 30 days. Required attachments: e-ticket/boarding pass (or itinerary PDF), proof of payment (card statement or payment confirmation), itemized lodging receipt if applicable. No per-diem for candidate travel.

maya (People Ops): Edge case 1 Candidate booked refundable fare on their corporate credit card (they used a personal card). They want to cancel later and get refunded. Does that change anything?

Priya (Finance): Refunds okay. We reimburse net amount paid at time of submission. If they get a refund after reimbursement, they must return the overpayment or finance will offset future payments. Document refund emails/credit on card.

dan (Hiring Manager): Candidate says they used AirBnB and host invoice only shows last name  not full name. Is that acceptable?

Priya (Finance): Host invoice must include dates and amount. If name mismatch, add a short attestation from the candidate confirming stay dates and the host confirmation email. Prefer hotels/OTAs but accept Airbnb when host invoice exists. Cash-only or "no invoice" stays are not reimbursable.

maya (People Ops): Any policy on booking class upgrades or seat selection fees?

tom (Recruiting Ops): We cover basic seat/checked bag fees that are standard for economy. Upgrades to premium economy/business require pre-approval from recruiting@redwood and justification (medical, long haul >8h). Seat selection for convenience occasionally approved; include receipt and note.

Priya (Finance): Also note mileage: if candidate drives, reimburse at company mileage rate per mile and they must provide start/end locations + odometer or Google Maps estimate. Parking/tolls with receipts are OK.

maya (People Ops): Example copy for candidates and interviewers to paste in expense app?

Priya (Finance): Sure, copy/paste: ```Expense title: Candidate travel - [Candidate name]\nTotal: $XXX.XX\nItems:\n- Flight (e-ticket attached) $YYY.YY\n- Ground transfer (receipt attached) $AA.AA\n- Lodging (itemized receipt attached) $BB.BB\nNotes: Booked by candidate; reimbursable up to $600 domestic cap. Candidate travel approved by recruiting@redwood on 2026-04-10. Partner/guest portions excluded.```

maya (People Ops): Great. I'll add this to the recruiting checklist and the interview packet. If anyone sees a corner case (visa courier, COVID test for travel, or expense splitting across multiple cards) flag here and we'll escalate. :wave:
